messages:
Alice M: Emergency: embeddings in eu-west1 returning sporadic 503s. Root cause looks like kv-cache eviction regression. Need expedited hotfix and signoff to push a patch. Plan: manual canary -> 5% -> 50% -> 100% over ~15m. Requesting image pin and rollcall. @OnCall please advise on SLO risk.
DeployBot: build detected: registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-2026-03-21. Attempted canary in eu-west1 but FAILED to allocate reserved GPUs: InsufficientCapacityError.
Ben K: eu-west1 reserved pool OOS. Options: 1) divert canary to eu-west2 dedicated pool, 2) use shared pool (higher latency). Prefer eu-west2 to minimize risk.
Carol S: SGTM eu-west2. Define rollback criteria: immediate rollback if 5xx_rate >1% over 3m OR P95 latency increases >200ms. Add alerts.
OnCall: Approve expedited window with strict guardrails. If we use shared pool expect p95 spikes; prefer dedicated eu-west2. Limit initial canary to 5% and enable auto-rollback.
Dave R: I'll pin and start canary. Command: `releasetool pin --service embeddings --image registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-2026-03-21 --region eu-west2 --canary 5% --auto-rollback true`.
Alice M: Need infra + model smoke acks before ramp. Smoke checklist: /health OK, dims correct, no OOMs, kv eviction rate reduced.
Ben K: Infra smoke on standby, will check GPU and eviction metrics 30s after canary start.
DeployBot: canary start cb-6799994321 in eu-west2 at 2026-03-21T14:32Z.
Dave R: Kicked canary cb-6799994321 -> 5% traffic to eu-west2 dedicated pool.
Ben K: /health -> {"ok":true}. KV eviction trending down in first 90s.
Carol S: Quick eval 50 prompts: 49 pass, 1 formatting edge-case fail (unrelated). Proceed to 50% after 3m monitor.
DeployBot: metrics @5%: 5xx_rate=0.12%, P95 +60ms. Within thresholds.
Alice M: Moving to 50%. Draft release note: "Hotfix: kv-cache eviction fix; emergency rollout to eu-west2; auto-rollback on 5xx>1% or P95+200ms."
OnCall: Monitoring active, 10m watch. Page if rollback triggers.
Dave R: 50% steady for 6m, no anomalies. Initiating full ramp.
Ben K: Full ramp started, dedicated pool holding.
DeployBot: deploy complete. Version pinned: registry.redwood/embeddings:hotfix-2026-03-21 (pinned by Dave R).
Alice M: Great, postmortem to follow with root cause (cache eviction policy regression) and follow-ups: autoscale reserved pool + earlier spillover policy. :white_check_mark:
Carol S: Adding follow-up ticket to release notes for autoscale and fallback.
DeployBot: closing canary cb-6799994321.
